about: Each category's total as one bar, split into the declared series. The total and the bottom segment are measured from the axis.

narrow.about: The revenue in a room 20rem wide, the column of a phone. All six month ticks fit, and the value axis measures its widest tick, €60,000.
narrow.title: Narrow room

replay.about: animate grows each segment from its base when the chart mounts, and Replay mounts the chart again. Under reduced motion recharts renders the bars at once.
replay.title: Animation

revenue.about: Revenue per plan per month in euros, with the largest plan at the bottom of each bar. A hairline in the panel's color parts the segments.
revenue.caption: Revenue grew to €43,600 in September, €24,800 of it from Scale plans.
revenue.label: Revenue per plan per month
revenue.title: Totals by plan

split.about: defaultIndex opens the tooltip at September when the chart first renders, with a row per plan. The pointer or the arrow keys move it from there.
split.caption: September's €43,600 split into €24,800 from Scale, €15,800 from Growth and €3,000 from Starter.
split.title: Tooltip

title: Stacked bar chart

unbooked.about: A range without rows renders the empty state in the plot's place, and no legend.
unbooked.caption: Revenue per plan per month.
unbooked.empty: No revenue booked in this period.
unbooked.title: Empty
